verbal_intervention.headline: Trump warned Warsh not to raise rates at September FOMC - presidential pressure collides with hot inflation into CPI Friday
verbal_intervention.source: Heisenberg Report (citing Fed-watcher reports) - carried Sep 6, sustained
verbal_intervention.summary: Trump warned Kevin Warsh not to raise rates at this month's FOMC. Political pressure against a hike while eurozone inflation prints 3.3% and Brent nears $100 sets up a credibility collision: if the Fed folds, inflation expectations risk unanchoring; if it hikes over the president's objection, Fed-independence stress enters the bond wildfire. CPI Friday Sep 11 decides. Carried into window, sustained.

verbal_intervention.headline: Iran vows response to US tanker strikes: American facilities 'exposed', US energy firms at risk
verbal_intervention.source: Christian Science Monitor (Sep 7) - carried, sustained; rhetoric now partially overtaken by kinetic Jordan strike (gp-001)
verbal_intervention.summary: Following CENTCOM's destruction of IRGC tankers, Iran vows revenge and states US facilities and energy firms in the region are 'exposed'. Rhetoric continues to escalate beyond proportionality language; coercion signaling explicitly names US commercial energy targets. In-window the vow was executed kinetically against Jordan-hosted US forces, confirming rhetoric-to-action conversion.

verbal_intervention.headline: Record $99bn yen intervention confirmed; funding from selling US Treasuries (~70% of reserves in USTs); August reserves post largest-ever drop ($95bn)
verbal_intervention.source: Bloomberg (Yokoyama Sep 6) / Japan Times (Sep 7) / Reuters via KTWB + Wolf Street (Sep 7) - carried, scale confirmed
verbal_intervention.summary: Japan's record yen intervention is quantified at $99bn with August foreign reserves posting the largest-ever drop (~$95bn); MoF data inference says a portion of foreign securities holdings, including US Treasuries, were sold to fund it. First confirmed official-sector UST selling this cycle - a structural new channel feeding US bond stress while the wildfire burns. Sustained/escalated rung with scale now fully confirmed.

verbal_intervention.headline: NEW: Bessent met Ueda and Katayama at G20, publicly pushed BOJ hikes; says markets are pricing in a BOJ rate hike (NHK)
verbal_intervention.summary: US Treasury Secretary publicly pressed BOJ hikes after meeting Governor Ueda and FM Katayama at the G20, saying he believes Japan will act to strengthen the yen and markets already price a BOJ hike. Extraordinary external pressure on an independent central bank days before CPI/FOMC - converts FX politics from bilateral (Katayama-Bessent line) to leader-level, raising both yen-upside and policy-sovereignty stress.

anonymous_leaks.headline: Traders-say: RBI extends dollar-selling intervention streak and revives aggressive pre-open intervention to arrest rupee slide
anonymous_leaks.source: Reuters (Sep 8 04:41Z, traders say) / The Hindu BusinessLine (pre-open revival)
anonymous_leaks.summary: Unofficial trader-sourced reporting (not RBI statement): the intervention streak extends after $8bn+ last week, and the RBI has revived aggressive pre-market intervention mirroring past episodes where it broke negative feedback loops. Anonymous-sourced FX defense at record-low rupee (fs-005) - reserve-drain channel widening across EM Asia.

central_bank_communication.headline: Fed September hike odds re-firmed ~58-60% ('more likely than not') into CPI Friday Sep 11; CPI MoM forecast 0.4% vs 0.1% prior; FOMC Sep 15-16
central_bank_communication.source: Forbes (Sep 8) / CNBC (Sep 8) / sembr digest (~60%) / FinancialJuice CPI prep
central_bank_communication.summary: Markets view a September hike as more likely than not; the call 'could hang on a tiny fraction' as consumer and producer releases land this week. CPI MoM consensus 0.4% (prior 0.1%) - a hot print would cement the hike and slam duration; a soft print re-opens the coin flip. Quiet-period political pressure (Trump-Warsh, vi-001) collides with the decision.

central_bank_communication.headline: ECB decision Thu Sep 10: 25bp hike to 2.50% upper-neutral 'all but certain'; ING 'pick your poison', MUFG 'moving to the next phase'
central_bank_communication.summary: Decision eve. A hike is all but certain - the reasoning is the open question: insurance against an energy-driven 3.3% HICP (energy 14.3% vs everything-else 2.2%) into a supply shock, with the deposit rate lifted to the upper end of neutral. Markets price more than economists; the risk is hiking into the bond wildfire without a fragmentation backstop.

central_bank_communication.headline: BOJ Sep 17-18 hike bets harden; yen at 7-month highs; 'bet small now to avoid a bigger shock later' framing
central_bank_communication.summary: Hawkish bets ramp into the September 17-18 meeting: yen gathered strength overnight to 7-month highs (~153.4-154.2 area), wages fastest since 1997, JGB ~2.86-3%. Reuters analysis frames the BOJ's dilemma - small steps now to avoid a disorderly larger move later - while Bessent publicly endorses hikes (vi-004). BOJ decision lands one week after the Fed's.

central_bank_communication.headline: PBOC resists yuan appreciation: weaker-than-expected fixings, dovish tone; yuan ~32-month high as export squeeze persists
central_bank_communication.source: Bloomberg (Aug 20 vintage, carried) / Reuters (Aug 31) - no fresh in-window print
central_bank_communication.summary: PBOC keeps using the daily fixing to slow yuan gains while domestic demand stays weak - appreciation resistance amid an export-led growth model. Carried standing; the corrected picture (yuan strong, PBOC leaning against appreciation) holds through the window with no fresh fixing news.

central_bank_communication.headline: China recap skepticism standing: bank/insurer shares slid on the Y300bn injection; SCMP 'more needed'; CNBC - credit demand stays weak
central_bank_communication.summary: The market verdict on the biggest recap in two decades is skepticism: bank and insurer shares slid on the news, analysts call for stronger fiscal support to reignite credit demand, and solvency vs NIM tradeoffs remain unresolved. Recap leg formalized but the transmission failure it tries to patch persists.

geopolitical_posture.headline: NEW MAJOR: Iran fires ~20 ballistic missiles at Jordan / US airbase; Jordan intercepts 18; explosions over the base - first direct Iran strike on US forces on third-country soil
geopolitical_posture.source: Petra (Jordan News Agency, ~02:57Z Sep 9) / Anadolu / Roya / Times of India / Reuters ('oil jumps 1% after Iran launches missiles Jordan')
geopolitical_posture.summary: The war crossed a threshold: Tehran retaliated for the tanker strikes by firing ~20 ballistic missiles at US-hosted infrastructure in Jordan; 18 destroyed out of 20 per the Jordanian army, multiple explosions filmed over the US airbase. First direct Iranian strike on US forces on third-country soil this cycle - opens a new front beyond the Gulf littoral and invites US retaliation beyond naval assets.

geopolitical_posture.headline: NEW ESCALATION: US destroys 5 Iranian oil tankers (up from 3) after IRGC targeted a US warship twice in two days
geopolitical_posture.summary: The US military struck five Iranian tankers after the IRGC targeted a US warship twice in 48 hours - the tanker war is now institutionalized and escalating in scale (3 -> 5 hulls destroyed). Each side's strike cycles are shortening; the exclusion-zone declaration (gp-003) would formalize an already-kinetic regime.

geopolitical_posture.headline: Iran restricted-zone declaration STILL 'coming days' - all coverage Sep 7 vintage; zone begins where US blockade ends; entrants face sanctions list
geopolitical_posture.source: Al-Monitor / Anadolu / Baird Maritime (Rezaei, SNSC) - carried, pending
geopolitical_posture.summary: The declared restricted maritime zone and Hormuz corridor maps remain unissued despite repeated 'coming days' vows. A standing, undischarged escalation commitment: when maps land, vessels entering the zone join a sanctions list - a self-executing escalation trigger the market has not yet priced as active.

geopolitical_posture.headline: Houthi campaign vs Saudi energy infrastructure stable in-window: 73 wounded, Jizan refinery hit; Riyadh condemns 'renewed' attacks; no fresh strike wave in window
geopolitical_posture.summary: The Saudi-infrastructure front holds at its escalated-but-stable plateau: Abha/Khamis Mushait/Jizan/Najran strikes with drones and ballistic missiles, fires-containment grind, 73 civilians injured. No fresh strike wave inside the window - a second theater held open rather than escalating.

supply_chain_disruption.headline: Brent ~99.1-99.7, closest approach yet to $100 ('heads for $100'); +1% on Jordan strike; $120 warned if attacks and slow Hormuz traffic persist
supply_chain_disruption.source: Reuters (Sep 9) / TradingEconomics (21:08Z Sep 8) / NBC News / CNBC TV18 (06:28 IST Sep 9)
supply_chain_disruption.summary: Brent printed session highs 99.65-99.67 this window - closest approach yet to the $100 wire - and jumped ~1% in early Asian trade after the Jordan strike. Canonical BZ=F wire still NOT breached; spot-vs-futures divergence stands. Experts warn $120+ if attacks and slow Hormuz traffic persist. The $100 psychological/technical rung is a live intraday risk.

supply_chain_disruption.headline: LNG squeeze sustained: multiyear-high prices, Asian spot near 4-month high, October loading windows squeezed; Qatar/UAE test ship-to-ship workarounds six months into the blockade
supply_chain_disruption.source: Business Standard (Sep 7) / The Edge Malaysia (Sep 8) / Euronews (Sep 8)
supply_chain_disruption.summary: Six months into the Hormuz blockade, LNG prices hold multiyear highs with Asian spot near 4-month highs and October loading windows squeezed; Qatar and UAE are testing ship-to-ship and rerouting workarounds. Structural squeeze persists for Asian buyers and European competition for marginal cargoes.

supply_chain_disruption.headline: NEW RUNG: TTF gas >75 EUR/MWh - European government bond yields at 15-year highs, worst sovereign selloff in years
supply_chain_disruption.source: Gate News (Sep 7) / RBC BlueBay (Sep 4: TTF >70, +140% vs pre-war) / Reuters commentary (Sep 8)
supply_chain_disruption.summary: Europe's energy shock has crossed into its sovereign debt market: TTF above EUR 75/MWh (up ~140% from pre-war) is driving the worst government-bond selloff in years with yields at 15-year highs. Goldman: much higher gas prices still needed by December for storage fill. Winter supply is the transmission channel from the Gulf war into euro_crisis.

supply_chain_disruption.headline: Hormuz transit constraint sustained: tanker traffic lowest since May (7 transits Monday); oil ships returning, LNG tankers still staying away
supply_chain_disruption.summary: The chokepoint regime persists: Hormuz tanker traffic lowest since May with 7 transits Monday; oil tanker traffic partially recovering while LNG carriers continue avoiding the strait. The zone declaration (gp-003) plus the Jordan strike keep re-risking the corridor; every transit datapoint is now a war-band marker.

regulatory_change.headline: China Y300bn ($45bn; Nikkei $54bn) recap of 8 state banks + insurers formalized - biggest in two decades; special bonds formalized
regulatory_change.source: Insurance Journal/Bloomberg (Sep 8) / Nikkei Asia / Caixin (Sep 7) - carried, formalized
regulatory_change.summary: Beijing formalized the coordinated capital injection into its largest banks and insurers (Y300bn special bonds; Nikkei counts $54bn across institutions) - the nation's biggest recapitalization in two decades. Strengthens buffers but markets read it as a distress patch, not stimulus (see cb-005).

regulatory_change.headline: Iran gasoline doubling took effect Tue Sep 8 - war-economy rationing/revenue push, politically the most sensitive lever
regulatory_change.source: Iran International (Sep 7-8) / Al Jazeera (Sep 8) / The National (Sep 7)
regulatory_change.summary: The doubling of outside-quota gasoline prices (to 100,000 rials/litre above 110 litres/month) took effect as planned - a war-economy rationing and revenue regime change. Direct trigger of the current unrest wave (su-001); an irreversible domestic-politics rung.

regulatory_change.headline: OCC + FDIC finalize supervisory redefinition ('unsafe or unsound practices' -> material financial distress threshold) - carried standing
regulatory_change.summary: US bank supervisors finalized the redefinition of 'unsafe or unsound practices' toward a material-financial-distress standard - a quiet lowering of the intervention trigger bar. Standing carried item; relevant if the bond wildfire reaches regional banks.

social_unrest.headline: Iran gasoline-price protests escalate: security forces deployed with mounted machine gun (Khorramabad), queues across cities, government urges citizens to cut back
social_unrest.source: Iran International (Sep 8 13:31 GMT+1) / Al Jazeera (Sep 8) / The National (Sep 7)
social_unrest.summary: The price doubling took effect with pre-emptive securitization: mounted machine guns in Khorramabad, fuel queues in several cities, state campaigns urging consumption cuts. Iran's war economy is cracking at home - 2019 precedent (protests in 100 cities after a similar doubling) is the regime's own reference scenario. Unpredictable domestic escalation vector alongside the kinetic fronts.

social_unrest.headline: Jakarta protests EASE after lawmaker pay-hike reversal; aftermath lingers
social_unrest.source: Sep 7 scan vintage - de-escalation tick, carried
social_unrest.summary: Indonesian protests continue easing after the pay-hike reversal; aftermath and grievances linger. De-escalation tick - carries no thread tags and is excluded from convergence.

social_unrest.headline: DRC Ebola (Bundibugyo) sustained/static: 6,686 cases / 3,226 deaths (Sep 8 govt figures); ECDC risk update Sep 7; WHO staffing/funding-crisis markers
social_unrest.summary: Outbreak holds at ~6,700 cases / 3,200+ deaths with no fresh in-window rung; ECDC maintained its risk assessment Sep 7. Bundibugyo species outrunning containment capacity amid WHO staffing and funding constraints. Sustained pandemic precursor - static, not escalating.

financial_stress_precursors.headline: UST 10Y ~4.78-4.80 test sustained; long-end dip-buyers emerge near 5% (30Y); 'meaningful spillover' framing stands; NY Fed rebuts de-dollarization
financial_stress_precursors.source: sembr Fed Watch (Sep 7) / Sep 8 scan vintage - carried
financial_stress_precursors.summary: The Treasury wildfire holds at the 4.8% test with buyers only at the long end (30Y near 5%); the 4.8%-break 'meaningful spillover' framing stands while official-sector UST selling (vi-003) adds a structural seller. NY Fed publicly rebutted de-dollarization - counter-narrative confirmation the topic is now mainstream.

financial_stress_precursors.headline: Equities grind: S&P below 7,700 standing; Asia stocks subdued Sep 9 on oil/yen (Reuters); VIX orderly risk-off
financial_stress_precursors.summary: Risk assets continue grinding lower on the inflation/war cocktail rather than panicking: S&P under 7,700 stands, Asian equities subdued as oil heads for $100 and the yen surges. Orderly deleveraging, not capitulation - the stress is building in bonds and FX, not yet equities.

financial_stress_precursors.headline: BTC ~$78.7K (-0.5% Sep 9), $264M liquidations Sep 8 pre-CPI after $208M rout - post-deleveraging calm, no fresh stress
financial_stress_precursors.summary: Crypto remains in post-deleveraging calm: BTC ground to ~$78,672 (-0.5%), forced liquidations $264M Sep 8 into CPI after the $208M Sep 7 rout and the sharpest deleveraging since 2023. Overhang is macro (CPI Friday), not crypto-internal. WATCH-state marker, no new rung.

financial_stress_precursors.headline: Liquid Network $320M breach aftermath standing - crypto infrastructure stress marker (carried)
financial_stress_precursors.summary: The $320M Liquid Network breach during the record deleveraging remains a standing infrastructure-stress marker; no fresh in-window developments. Adds fragility context to the crypto thread without escalating it.

financial_stress_precursors.headline: ESCALATED: Rupee hits record low 92.33; RBI intervention 'limits fall'; worst EM-Asia FX day in 8 weeks tail
financial_stress_precursors.source: Economic Times (record low 92.33) / Reuters (Sep 8) - carried + fresh rung
financial_stress_precursors.summary: The rupee printed a record low of 92.33/USD with RBI sales limiting the fall - a fresh record-low rung on top of the peso's record low and the 'worst day in 8 weeks' oil-spillover session. Reserve-drain contagion channel widening: two record-low EM-Asian currencies now absorbing the oil shock.

financial_stress_precursors.headline: Shilling 60-70% recession-within-12-months call standing into CPI (carried)
financial_stress_precursors.summary: Gary Shilling's 60-70% recession-probability call with consumer warnings stands as the recession-consensus outside marker into CPI Friday. Carried standing; no fresh in-window iteration.

financial_stress_precursors.headline: Japan bond-rout repatriation channel sustained: JGB ~2.86-3% on hawkish bets; global capital tide turning toward Japan (carried)
financial_stress_precursors.summary: The repatriation channel stands: JGB yields holding ~2.86-3% on hawkish BOJ bets keep pulling global capital toward Japan, feeding the UST-selling leg (vi-003). The tide-turn framework - Japan as exporter rather than importer of capital - remains the structural undercurrent.

financial_stress_precursors.headline: France>Italy OAT/BTP inversion mainstreamed: El-Erian - 'French bonds now scare markets more than Italian BTPs, Rome beats Paris' (carried)
financial_stress_precursors.source: Money.it International (El-Erian, Sep 6 vintage) / stockwirex (Sep 6) - carried
financial_stress_precursors.summary: The France-over-Italy borrowing-cost inversion stands and is now mainstream commentary (El-Erian): funds sell OATs and buy BTPs on deficit and political risk. Structural euro-area fragmentation marker ahead of tomorrow's ECB hike - a hike that raises both Paris's and Rome's debt-service costs.

convergence_detection.methodology: Sum of (imminence x impact) for all findings tagged with each thread across different categories. Thread score = min(100, round(raw_sum x 0.17) + 5x(categories_beyond_2)). Threshold: >=50 = DEVELOPING, >=100 = ACTIVE (capped). De-escalation-tick findings (su-002 Jakarta easing) carry no thread tags and are excluded from convergence. Hand-assessment layer (blackwatch-macro-event.json) applies confirmed-state-change rule on the 0-200 composite scale and remains the live board.
